reader_summary.overview: Today’s episode looks a little different. We are exploring whether podcasts can be a source of investment alpha. I analyze performance data from over 200 companies covered on Business Breakdowns since 2021. I examine momentum patterns, discuss both winners and losers, and share insights on using podcasts for investment pattern recognition rather than direct stock picks.

key_points.text: We are exploring whether podcasts can be a source of investment alpha.
I analyze performance data from over 200 companies covered on Business Breakdowns since 2021.
The episode concludes with practical thoughts on how podcast insights can serve as an educational starting point for business research and understanding.
